S16.what: W ladder: 16-bit blocks of 0x00/0xFF over lanes-constant (raw toggles; encoded only DMI)

V16.what: V ladder: 16-bit blocks of 0x0F/0xF0 over 0x0F (raw = encoded toggles)

S32.what: W ladder: 32-bit blocks of 0x00/0xFF over lanes-constant (raw toggles; encoded only DMI)

V32.what: V ladder: 32-bit blocks of 0x0F/0xF0 over 0x0F (raw = encoded toggles)

S64.what: W ladder: 64-bit blocks of 0x00/0xFF over lanes-constant (raw toggles; encoded only DMI)

V64.what: V ladder: 64-bit blocks of 0x0F/0xF0 over 0x0F (raw = encoded toggles)

S128.what: W ladder: 128-bit blocks of 0x00/0xFF over lanes-constant (raw toggles; encoded only DMI)

V128.what: V ladder: 128-bit blocks of 0x0F/0xF0 over 0x0F (raw = encoded toggles)

S256.what: W ladder: 256-bit blocks of 0x00/0xFF over lanes-constant (raw toggles; encoded only DMI)

V256.what: V ladder: 256-bit blocks of 0x0F/0xF0 over 0x0F (raw = encoded toggles)

E32.what: encoded wide-path residual at 32 bits: V - S - (n/31)(V16 - S16), the pins' share removed

E64.what: encoded wide-path residual at 64 bits: V - S - (n/31)(V16 - S16), the pins' share removed

E128.what: encoded wide-path residual at 128 bits: V - S - (n/31)(V16 - S16), the pins' share removed

E256.what: encoded wide-path residual at 256 bits: V - S - (n/31)(V16 - S16), the pins' share removed

Sc1.what: E99's `half`: the 32 B halves 0xFF then 0x00, over lanes-constant

c256.what: S256 - S128/3: a 256-bit path beyond the narrower ones (within-line edges)

c256_cyc.what: S256 - S128/2: the same with each path's line-to-line edge counted

phase.what: ones in the first 32 B against the second: where the register load's half sits

tie18.what: DRAM: 448 more ones, 64 pins high on both, no toggle (E99's tie18)

l2_ones.what: L2: 448 more ones, no DRAM, no pins

cal.what: DRAM zeros over L2 zeros: the DRAM path's own traffic, for the DDR die rail's scale

D.what: E99's period step: 8,192 distinct lines over 2
